brief:
The European Union has committed to working with Israel's next government based on shared democratic values, Middle East Eye reported. The pledge comes as Palestinians in the occupied West Bank remain subject to what rights groups describe as apartheid conditions.

The EU's statement emphasizes alignment on democratic governance while the situation facing Palestinians under Israeli control persists unchanged. The commitment signals continuity in EU-Israel relations regardless of shifts in Israeli political leadership.

title: EU pledges cooperation with Israel's incoming government
